subject: Logic
title: Soundness and Completeness
description: A 60-second lesson on Soundness and Completeness.

hook.text: A logical system can have a fatal flaw: proving things that aren't true, or failing to prove things that are.

buildup.text: Soundness means every provable statement is actually true. The system never lies.

discovery.text: Completeness means every true statement is provable. The system misses nothing.

twist.text: Gödel proved that powerful enough systems can't be both complete and consistent. Something must give.

climax.text: We choose soundness: better to miss some truths than to prove falsehoods.

quiz.question: What does soundness guarantee about a logical system?
